edges.reason: transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of the token movement.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() to decrement the caller allowance.
approve sets the allowance for _msgSender() as owner.
deliver uses _msgSender() as the burnt-from address.
constructor assigns the entire initial reflection supply to _msgSender().
onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender() before setTaxFeePercent.
onlyOwner modifier gates setMaxTxPercent on the caller identity.
onlyOwner modifier gates setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled on the caller identity.
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline, making execution time miner-influenced.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp directly as the Uniswap deadline.
transfer delegates all movement logic to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates all movement logic to _transfer.
transferFrom updates the spender allowance through _approve.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
_transfer hands off to _tokenTransfer for the actual accounting.
_transfer conditionally calls swapAndLiquify before the token movement completes.
_transfer reads and mutates reflected balances.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount limit for non-owner accounts.
_transfer compares contract balance against minimumTokensBeforeSwap.
_transfer checks whether the sender is the Uniswap pair.
_transfer reads swapAndLiquifyEnabled before swapping.
_transfer reads the inSwapAndLiquify reentrancy flag.
_transfer checks the fee exemption mapping for both parties.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferStandard when neither party is excluded.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferToExcluded when only the recipient is excluded.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferFromExcluded when only the sender is excluded.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferBothExcluded when both parties are excluded.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee when takeFee is false.
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee after the transfer completes.
_tokenTransfer branches on the _isExcluded flags of sender and recipient.
_transferStandard applies fees through _reflectFee.
_transferStandard credits liquidity tokens through _takeLiquidity.
_transferStandard obtains all amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard obtains the current reflection rate.
_transferStandard updates reflected balances of both parties.
_transferStandard touches the true balance mapping.
_transferToExcluded applies fees through _reflectFee.
_transferToExcluded credits liquidity through _takeLiquidity.
_transferToExcluded obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferToExcluded credits the excluded recipient true balance.
_transferFromExcluded applies fees through _reflectFee.
_transferFromExcluded credits liquidity through _takeLiquidity.
_transferFromExcluded obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferFromExcluded debits the excluded sender true balance.
_transferBothExcluded applies fees through _reflectFee.
_transferBothExcluded credits liquidity through _takeLiquidity.
_transferBothExcluded obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferBothExcluded adjusts both parties true balances.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflected fee and burn.
_reflectFee accumulates the true fee into _tFeeTotal.
_reflectFee accumulates the true burn into _tBurnTotal.
_reflectFee reduces the total supply by the burn amount.
_getValues calls _getTValues for true-value amounts.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflected-value amounts.
_getValues fetches the current rate from _getRate.
_getTValues computes the tax part with calculateTaxFee.
_getTValues computes the burn part with calculateBurnFee.
_getTValues computes the liquidity part with calculateLiquidityFee.
calculateTaxFee reads _taxFee as the percentage.
calculateBurnFee reads _burnFee as the percentage.
calculateLiquidityFee reads _charitypoolFee as the percentage.
_getRate divides rSupply by tSupply obtained from _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply starts from _rTotal as reflected supply.
_getCurrentSupply starts from _tTotal as true supply.
_getCurrentSupply iterates over the _excluded array.
_getCurrentSupply subtracts excluded reflected balances.
_getCurrentSupply subtracts excluded true balances.
_takeLiquidity converts the true liquidity amount using the current rate.
_takeLiquidity credits reflected liquidity to the contract address.
_takeLiquidity conditionally credits true liquidity to the contract address.
_takeLiquidity checks whether the contract is reward-excluded.
swapAndLiquify performs its external swap before downstream ETH handling, only guarded by the inSwapAndLiquify flag.
swapAndLiquify forwards ETH to an external address after the swap, an external interaction point.
swapAndLiquify accumulates the contract ETH balance into _tCharitypoolTotal.
swapAndLiquify reads the marketing pool address as the ETH recipient.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router as the swap target.
swapTokensForEth hands control to the external Uniswap router with an attacker-influenced deadline value.
TransferCharitypoolETH executes the raw ETH transfer to the recipient.
setTaxFeePercent writes the _taxFee state variable.
setBurnFeePercent writes the _burnFee state variable.
setCharitypoolFeePercent writes the _charitypoolFee state variable.
setMaxTxPercent recomputes and writes _maxTxAmount.
setNumTokensSellToAddToLiquidity writes minimumTokensBeforeSwap.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled writes swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
excludeFromReward sets the _isExcluded flag for the account.
excludeFromReward pushes the account onto the _excluded array.
excludeFromReward snapshots the true balance of the account.
includeInReward clears the _isExcluded flag for the account.
includeInReward removes the account from the _excluded array.
includeInReward zeroes the excluded true balance of the account.
excludeFromFee sets the fee exemption flag to true.
includeInFee sets the fee exemption flag to false.
deliver derives the reflected amount from _getValues.
deliver subtracts the reflected amount from the caller balance.
deliver reduces _rTotal by the reflected amount.
deliver credits _tFeeTotal with the delivered amount.
_approve writes the owner/spender entry of _allowances.
removeAllFee zeroes _taxFee after saving the previous value.
removeAllFee zeroes _burnFee after saving the previous value.
removeAllFee zeroes _charitypoolFee after saving the previous value.
restoreAllFee restores _taxFee from the saved value.
restoreAllFee restores _burnFee from the saved value.
restoreAllFee restores _charitypoolFee from the saved value.
constructor mints the entire reflected supply to the deployer.
constructor sets the immutable Uniswap router reference.
constructor creates and stores the Uniswap pair address.
constructor marks owner and contract as fee-exempt.
recipient parameter drives the transfer destination.
amount parameter drives the transferred quantity.
sender parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
from parameter is the source account of _transfer.
to parameter is the destination account of _transfer.
spender parameter is the allowance beneficiary in approve.
tAmount parameter is the true amount processed by _transferStandard.
tokenAmount parameter is the amount swapped in swapTokensForEth.
maxTxPercent parameter is an input to the max transaction computation.
maxTxDecimals parameter feeds the exponent used in the max transaction computation.
takeFee local records whether the fee exemption applies to this transfer.
contractTokenBalance local holds the contract balance used to trigger the swap.
currentRate local caches the reflection rate inside _transferStandard.
tLiquidity local carries the liquidity amount credited by _takeLiquidity.
path local holds the [token, WETH] swap route passed to the router.

normalization_plan.reason: Destination parameter is only meaningful inside the transfer entrypoint that forwards it to _transfer.
Amount parameter exists solely to size the balance movement performed by transfer.
Sender parameter is consumed only by transferFrom to debit the allowance owner.
From parameter is the local source binding of the internal _transfer routine.
To parameter is the local destination binding of the internal _transfer routine.
Spender parameter is only used to key the allowance written by approve.
tAmount parameter is the true amount consumed by the standard transfer path.
tokenAmount parameter is only used as the router swap input amount.
Percentage parameter exists only to recompute _maxTxAmount in the setter.
Decimals parameter exists only as the exponent inside the same setter.
takeFee is a temporary flag computed and used within _transfer._transferStandard.
contractTokenBalance is a scratch balance compared against the swap threshold inside _transfer.
currentRate is a cached rate used only inside the standard transfer routine.
tLiquidity is a transient liquidity amount generated and consumed in the transfer path.
path is a temporary route array built solely for the router swap call.
